text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp—even in an unfamiliar 
environment, Symboli Kris S carried out 
her training quietly and methodically.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Heh.
choice_data_list: Good work. We're done for today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, Kris S! Are you done with training?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's have a BBQ-showw!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It looks like there's a rental BBQ area 
nearby!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And so, Taiki-san and I got talking about 
how we'd love to have an authentic BBQ... 
So, um... this is an invitation!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S must surely find this nostalgic! 
America is the land of BBQ— I want you to 
enjoy the taste of home, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, why don't you join in too?!

Symboli Kris S stares intently this way. I 
am interested in authentic BBQ, and... 
above all, it might be a good way for her 
to unwind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. I am... well-versed in... 
barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoo~! That's the spirit! BBQ party, let's 
go!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... is changing clothes also a part of 
BBQ etiquette?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Ah... casual and―― ...should be―― agile 
and light.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! BBQ is a casual home party! This is 
a real BBQ☆"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Hehe, it really does lift my 
spirits!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's start by chopping the 
vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Wait a moment. From here on out—you will 
follow my lead."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
First—there is something that must be 
decided. —What kind of meat—we are going 
to grill.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The star of a BBQ is――meat. ――Until that 
is decided... nothing can begin."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is truly a Pitmaster...! In Japan, 
you'd call it—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The BBQ Magistrate!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san, you seem somewhat lively. So 
you really did love BBQ after all...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—So... everyone. Do you have... your meat 
of choice?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... when it comes to BBQ meat, 
there's spare ribs, brisket, pulled 
pork... so many kinds!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I love the spare ribs! They're tender yet 
chewy, simply delicious!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Authentic spare ribs...! I'd love to try 
some!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Understood. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Pre-seasoning—complete.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Authentic BBQ really is quite elaborate, 
isn't it...! Just like I read in the 
books—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Kris S-san, what are you 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Making a makeshift stove, that is.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah—come to think of it, I read about that 
in a book! It's the origin of barbecue!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In the past, people would steam what they 
hunted in pits dug as makeshift ovens... 
And that was the origin of barbecue!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A food culture passed down continuously 
since ancient times... It feels so 
romantic...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'll make you taste it. —Just you wait.

However, building a stove from scratch 
will take time... Renting a machine might 
also be an option.
choice_data_list:
Let's use the rental high-powered kamado 
cooker!

Let's all work hard and build a kamado 
together!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelming firepower... Could such a 
thing really exist...?
choice_data_list: Looks like it's on the rental list.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then—let us do that. —One must 
also make time—to enjoy oneself, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: OK! I'll go rent it right awaaay!

Thanks to the machine she borrowed, the 
spare ribs are grilled in no time.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh~! Kris S, look over here, please! There 
are woodchips, yes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I see. —We can smoke it, then. All of 
you—what do you want to eat? —State your 
requests.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am! BBQ Magistrate-sama! I want to 
eat pork tenderloin!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Rob Roy, what about you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes, Magistrate-sama! Well then, um...! 
I'd like to eat that \"garlic shrimp\" 
from the Western novel I read before!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. —Leave it to me. ...Trainer, you 
make up your mind too.

And so, Symboli Kris S, serving as the BBQ 
commander, lively answered every request—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Sounds wonderful, yes! Making it 
together will surely be lots of fun, yes!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I want to try building a hearth 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see—Then... first—let's lay the bricks.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Should I line them up~ like this? Hmm~... 
It looks kinda uneven, yes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Adjust with the soil—build it carefully.

And so, under Symboli Kris S's direction, 
we worked hard to build a brick stove—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's feeneeshed~! Now we can grill spare 
ribs non-stop!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Ah... steaming it―― takes time, but―― 
wait, a moment.
(Sizzle... crackle crackle crackle...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Maybe it's because we put so much 
effort into preparing it. It looks even 
more delicious now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It's almost time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――It is complete.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoo~! Good smell, good color! It looks 
so, so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I never imagined we'd get to enjoy 
such an authentic BBQ; it feels like a 
dream...!
choice_data_list: Let's all dig in right aw—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Mission Accomplished. If you are 
to――hold a BBQ again, ――feel free to call 
me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second, please! Kris S-san, 
aren't you going to eat...?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What!? Why not!? Let's eat together~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Why?! Because I want to eat together, of 
course! That's why I invited you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Is that... how it is...?
choice_data_list:
Did you think your only job was to make 
it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah—if everyone is satisfied... —then that 
is—fine...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It was so much fun getting to 
experience authentic cooking again after 
so long!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So—right until the end! I want us to enjoy 
eating together, yes I dooo!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'd love to join you like this too! 
That is, if you don't mind, Kris 
S-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I do not—understand your intent. —Were 
my actions... mistaken?

"Would someone really want to eat with the 
likes of me?"— her expression showed that 
kind of bewilderment.

"For now, as long as you understand this 
much, that will be plenty."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S, you should eat some spareribs too! 
Let's party!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...Yeah. If you two... are fine with 
that, then so am I.

Returning Taiki Shuttle and the others' 
smiles as she said that, she looked 
satisfied—even if a hint of bewilderment 
remained.
